chapter_level.guidance: The daughter Sneha is the one who reads her father's face, proposes and defends the ઍરટૅક્સી solution, gives it voice-commands, pilots the whole trip, and turns out to have already solved the actual problem the night before ('હું કાલે સાંજે જ લઈ આવેલી') — while the father is anxious, forgetful, and reliant on her. Keep this exactly as the text has it in explanation, real_life_example and recall answers: Sneha as the competent, foresighted one and Nishchal as the one who needed help. Do not soften her agency into 'a helpful daughter' and do not add a lesson about girls-vs-boys that the chapter never states — the text shows this through what she does, it never says it.
